nodes.name: DateField.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin CMS form control for date entry: an outline Button trigger showing the current YYYY-MM-DD value that opens a Popover-hosted Calendar picker, converting picked days to and from ISO date strings with date-fns parseISO/format.

nodes.name: accordion.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix-based accordion primitives (Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent) restyled with square corners, hairline borders, and a chevron indicator for the site's editorial design system.

nodes.name: alert.tsx
nodes.summary: Alert component family (Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription) with default and destructive variants defined via class-variance-authority, bordered with hairlines in the monochrome editorial palette.

nodes.name: avatar.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix avatar primitives (Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback) for rendering profile imagery with a styled placeholder fallback in the editorial design system.

nodes.name: breadcrumb.tsx
nodes.summary: Breadcrumb navigation primitives (Breadcrumb, List, Item, Link, Page, Separator, Ellipsis) built on Radix Slot for as-child link composition, with chevron separators and an ellipsis indicator for truncated trails.

nodes.name: calendar.tsx
nodes.summary: Calendar component wrapping react-day-picker, remapping every sub-element's classes onto the editorial styles and reusing the shared Button (buttonVariants) for day cells and navigation through the CalendarDayButton override.
nodes.languageNotes: react-day-picker styling is applied entirely by merging its classNames prop through cn() with Tailwind utilities, and day cells delegate to the shared buttonVariants factory from button.tsx.

nodes.name: card.tsx
nodes.summary: Card layout primitives (Card, CardHeader, CardFooter, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent) providing the square-cornered, hairline-bordered containers used across the site's editorial layouts.

nodes.name: chart.tsx
nodes.summary: Recharts wrapper layer exporting ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, and ChartStyle; provides a React-context-based chart config with CSS-variable theming and payload-config helpers for series labels, icons, and colors.
nodes.languageNotes: Themes charts by injecting CSS custom properties (--color-*) scoped to a data-chart attribute id, supporting light and dark palettes from a single ChartConfig object.

nodes.name: command.tsx
nodes.summary: Command palette primitives built on cmdk: Command, CommandDialog (a Dialog-wrapped palette), Input, List, Empty, Group, Item, Separator, and Shortcut, restyled for the monochrome editorial theme.

nodes.name: context-menu.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix context menu with fifteen exported parts — menu, trigger, content, items, checkbox and radio items, labels, groups, submenus, separators, and shortcuts — restyled with square corners and hairline dividers.

nodes.name: dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix dialog primitives (Dialog, Portal, Overlay, Trigger, Close, Content, Header, Footer, Title, Description) with a built-in close button and subtle fade/slide animations adapted to the editorial design.

nodes.name: drawer.tsx
nodes.summary: Drawer component family built on Vaul for mobile-style bottom sheets: Drawer (with optional background scaling), Portal, Overlay, Trigger, Close, Content, Header, Footer, Title, and Description.

nodes.name: dropdown-menu.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix dropdown menu with fifteen exported parts covering triggers, content, items, checkbox/radio items, labels, groups, submenus, separators, and shortcuts, restyled for the editorial design system.

nodes.name: form.tsx
nodes.summary: react-hook-form integration layer exporting Form, FormField, useFormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, and FormMessage; wires field state, error messages, and aria attributes through nested React contexts and composes the shared Label primitive.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines react-hook-form's useFormContext with a custom FieldContext so deeply nested controls can resolve their field's name, id, and error state without prop drilling.

nodes.name: hover-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix hover card primitives (HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent) for hover-triggered preview popovers styled with hairline borders.

nodes.name: input-otp.tsx
nodes.summary: One-time-code input built on input-otp: InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot (with active caret and separator indication), and InputOTPSeparator for grouped verification codes.

nodes.name: label.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix Label primitive styled for form field captions in the editorial design system; reused as the base of form.tsx's FormLabel.

nodes.name: menubar.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix menubar with sixteen exported parts for a horizontal menu bar — menus, triggers, content, items, checkbox/radio items, submenus, groups, separators, and shortcuts — restyled square and monochrome.

nodes.name: navigation-menu.tsx
nodes.summary: Radix navigation menu primitives (NavigationMenu, List, Item, Content, Trigger, Link, Indicator, Viewport) plus the navigationMenuTriggerStyle cva factory, used for the site's header navigation.

nodes.name: DateField
nodes.summary: Controlled date field for CMS forms: validates the YYYY-MM-DD value with a regex, parses it to a Date via parseISO, opens a Popover with a Calendar picker, and emits a formatted yyyy-MM-dd string back through onChange when a day is selected.

nodes.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
nodes.summary: Renders the chevron-right separator between breadcrumb items, merging slot props with Tailwind classes.

nodes.name: BreadcrumbEllipsis
nodes.summary: Renders the more-horizontal ellipsis indicator shown when a breadcrumb trail is collapsed, with an aria-hidden decorative icon.

nodes.name: Calendar
nodes.summary: Wraps react-day-picker's DayPicker and remaps every calendar sub-element (months, weekdays, days, captions, selections) onto the editorial styles, formatting captions per locale and composing the shared Button variants for navigation controls.

nodes.name: CalendarDayButton
nodes.summary: Day-cell button override that merges day-picker default classes with buttonVariants, auto-focuses the selected cell via a ref and effect for keyboard navigation, and derives aria labels from the day's date.

nodes.name: ChartStyle
nodes.summary: Injects a style tag of CSS custom properties (--color-*) scoped to a data-chart id, deriving colors from each ChartConfig entry for both light and dark themes; returns null when no colors are configured.

nodes.name: getPayloadConfigFromPayload
nodes.summary: Helper resolving a chart series' config (label, icon, color) from a Recharts payload object, unwrapping nested payload types to locate the matching config key.

nodes.name: CommandDialog
nodes.summary: Command palette modal: nests cmdk's Command inside a DialogContent shell with a search header and scrollable list styling.

nodes.name: FormField
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper around react-hook-form's Controller that clears the field's error on change and supplies FieldContext so nested controls can identify their field.

nodes.name: useFormField
nodes.summary: Hook that combines react-hook-form's form context with the surrounding FieldContext to expose the field's name, generated id, aria-invalid flag, and error message state to FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, and FormMessage.
